description:
Outcome: owner can inspect mobile gardener and coordinator journeys, from brief.md Users/Constraints and owner map deferral.
Scope: sign-in/resend, applications/preferences/receipt, own allocation/dates and problem reports; coordinator roster, application/available-plot controls, waiting list and problems; locked pre-February allocation state. Excludes: plot map, all-plot holder overview and functional persistence.
Acceptance: large readable text, plain language, labeled controls, keyboard/focus flow, status not conveyed by color alone.
Behaviour: represent loading, empty, error, retry and success states.
Verification: walkthrough, zoom and keyboard review with fictional data. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: schematic prototype sufficient.
title: Mobile first-version journey prototype
